name: loader-mullion
title: Mullion loader
description: An app narrows from a wide workspace to a pocket-sized frame. Its sidebar folds into a navigation rail, a two-column card row stacks beneath the header, and every block finds its new margin before the wide layout opens again. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.
